convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <tmp.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import resolves. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs; default and static-print exports are byte-identical (the contract's identical-by-construction claim).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-pen budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, contract root #tsHost section.ts, Chromium via playwright 1.58.2 (headless shell 145.0.7632.6), deviceScaleFactor 2. Capture protocol: Google Fonts origins blocked + @font-face injection serving Heebo from the SAME TTF the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf); browser launched with --font-render-hinting=none --disable-font-subpixel-positioning (aligns Chromium glyph metrics with the pen renderer's unhinted shaper); animations/transitions frozen; scrollbars hidden (chrome, not content); root nudged onto the integer CSS-pixel grid via position:relative top/left (paint-only, sub-pixel); fonts ready; pointer parked after contracted clicks; self-consistency gate (double screenshot, byte-equal).
convergence.iterationNotes: It1 authoring from extracted geometry: 10/12 within budget (config-error 2.89%, narrow-scroll 1.29%) — cause: fractional root origin (0.25/0.75px) sub-pixel phase. It2 integer-grid snap: 11/12 (config-error 2.34%). It3 unhinted browser font metrics (long-string advance drift eliminated): 12/12 within budget, worst 0.465%. It4 baseline compensation at 6 font sizes measured by probe (pen places glyphs 1css px lower than Chromium at most sizes; 0 at 14/16px): worst 0.353%. It5 full per-size baseline table (19 sizes probed, tweaks -1/-2/0): final 0.024-0.159%. All tooling probes (export-scale, gradient, dash, shadow, baseline) ran outside the frame-fix budget as measurement, not fix rounds; the five iterations above are the honest author->export->compare rounds.

normalizationRecipe.fontSwap: None required at the CSS layer: the prototype is already Heebo-native (--font-ui Heebo-first, SVG text hardcodes 'Heebo, sans-serif'). Serving mechanics: Google Fonts blocked at capture; Heebo served via injected @font-face from pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf — the same file this .pen's fonts block references.
normalizationRecipe.notes: Identity injections (13 of 27) are recorded because the injection IS the reconciliation record even when Bill's value already equals the token value. Dark :root block left untouched — dark is uncontracted (design-rules rule 25) and arrives later as a token swap; every token bound here carries its dark value in the library/local definitions.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: series color assignment (all plots, swatches, card rows, scrub dots)
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: blue-first categorical order --cat1..15 (#3B82F6 first; Bill's comment: "Every swatch is drawn from v2.0 (Hemlock)'s 15-colour set; the ORDER is blue-first")
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Chart-series roles bind by SERIES ORDER to the palette's priority order (hemlock rule: "Always assign in priority order"), never by hue-matching. Series 1 turns purple #8951F0; slots 02/03/05/15 coincide with Bill's values. Marker colors ride the same cycle (next unused slots), preserving the never-repeats-a-line rule.
Gridlines sit back as muted separators; no Hemlock chart-gridline role exists, and sem-borders-muted (#D5D3D0) is the named muted-border role. Value lightens slightly — token-true.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: axis baseline + tick stems + tick text + scrub line (--axis #6E7270, one coupled variable)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Hemlock chart rules name sem-text-meta for axis labels; the prototype couples baseline/stems/scrub-line to the same variable, so the coupled surfaces bind the same role (#5E5954). If the designer wants a dedicated axis-line role, that is a remap ruling.
Hemlock explicitly owns threshold/reference lines via chart-threshold (-> sem-background-action #3A6AF8). Role-first: the line turns blue. Deliberate, highly visible divergence from Bill's orange.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: info-card drop shadow (feDropShadow dy 3, stdDeviation 5, black 16%)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The floating info card is a card/tooltip; shadow-md is its named elevation. Rethemed in normalization (findReplaces) and bound in the .pen effect. NAMING DRIFT FLAGGED: skill docs name the color token shadow-md-color (no prefix, "semantics by nature"); the live library carries it as prim-shadow-md-color (themed #0000001A/#0000005C). Bound the live name; the doc/canvas naming divergence is a designer-visible report item, not improvised around.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: tile toggle hover background (--surface-2, unrendered in contracted states)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Button hover surface role (gray-50), not the taupe rowHover (rows, not buttons). Injection recorded for the normalization table; no frame renders it (hover uncontracted).

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: component composition (SVG-drawn info card, hand-rolled legend rows, Show/Hide tiles)
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: engine-drawn card with width formula 60+chars*6.4 and viewBox-aware scale clamp; flex legend; pill-button tiles
tokenJudgmentCalls.boundToken: (none — frames carry prototype geometry with token paint)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Hemlock has ChartTooltip / ChartLegend / InteractiveLegend, but they are different designs that cannot reproduce the executable spec's geometry (card scale-compensation clamp, edge push-back, tile pill semantics). Under the two-oracle split the .pen is the pixel oracle OF THIS PROTOTYPE; composing library components would fail every pixel compare. Divergence is designer-visible here, not silently resolved.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: gradient area fills (line color fading 32%->2%, one gradient per fill)
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: runtime SVG linearGradient stops: series color at stop-opacity 0.32 / 0.02
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Pen gradient stops bind color+position only (alpha rides the hex), so the fade RULE is materialized as token pairs — light derived from the light palette value, dark from the dark value. Alphas pinned to hex-representable 0x52/0x05 (82/255, 5/255) and the normalized prototype carries the same exact alphas (findReplaces), so a base-token swap mechanically re-derives the fades.

prototypeDefectsSeen.note: Tile toggle flips BOTH accessible name AND aria-pressed. Not pixel-visible; frames carry the rendered truth (Hide/Show verbs).

prototypeDefectsSeen.flag: NEW: preset info-card scale is computed before the legend reflows the svg
prototypeDefectsSeen.note: The engine computes the card's scale clamp k from the svg's rendered width AT render time, but the legend is appended AFTER the scrubber preset renders, shrinking the svg. In legend-bearing states the preset card renders at effective scale k*s = 0.8795 (below the 0.89 floor the clamp intends) instead of 1.0. Captured as rendered (multi-series-legend / legend-hidden / tiles / series-hidden frames carry it); geometry probe asserts the 194.4x104 vb card at the effective scale. A pointer-driven re-render (post-legend) would use the settled width — only the PRESET render has the stale k. Never fixed in frames.

prototypeDefectsSeen.flag: NEW: dark-mode info-card colors bypass the token layer
prototypeDefectsSeen.note: Engine hardcodes tipBg #17263F / tipBorder #2E4368 for dark mode (line 9073) instead of reading tokens. Dark is uncontracted (rule 25) — no frame impact; flagged for the future dark-theme swap.
